asked.item: Is there an endpoint to edit a comment
Is there an endpoint to delete a comment

verdict.reason: The comments page and the public operation index list only list, get and post endpoints for comments, with no edit or delete endpoint.

steps.text: The Comments API has three endpoints: List Comments (GET /v2/comments), Get Comment (GET /v2/comments/:commentId) and Post Comment (POST /v2/comments).
Blotato's public operation index covers its public operations. For comments it lists only GET /v2/comments, POST /v2/comments and GET /v2/comments/{commentId}, so it shows no edit or delete endpoint.
